text: No, the 2025 loss is not yet confirmed or confirmed as persistent. While Hansen data indicates a ~13.5 ha tree-cover loss in 2025 (3.91% of the asset), this is the latest year in the series and lacks corroboration from later observations. The evidence only identifies a *candidate* loss event—it does not confirm whether the change is permanent, its cause (e.g., fire, harvesting), or whether it qualifies as deforestation or land-use change. Further monitoring is needed to assess persistence.
